CustomField.description: Derived from Current_Stage__c. Maps stage to responsible team for bottleneck reporting.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(Current_Stage__c), "Distributor Submission", "Distributor", "Functional Head Review", "Distributor", "Leadership Review", "Leadership Team", "Management Review", "Leadership Team", "Regulatory Processing", "Regulatory Team", "Document Collection", "Regulatory Team", "Completed", "Completed", "Unknown" )
CustomField.label: Assigned Team
